subject: Mobile Development
title: Full-Disk Encryption
description: A micro-lesson that makes Full-Disk Encryption usable.

hook.text: If someone steals your phone, they can remove the storage chip. But the data is encrypted.

buildup.text: Full-disk encryption scrambles every byte on the device until unlocked by your passcode.

discovery.text: iOS has had full-disk encryption by default since 2014. Android followed shortly after.

twist.text: Law enforcement has struggled to access encrypted phones, sparking the Apple vs. FBI debate.

climax.text: Full-disk encryption is the last defense when physical access to the device is lost.

punchline.text: Without your passcode, the data is unreadable.

quiz.question: What does full-disk encryption protect against?
options: Data theft when the physical device is stolen
